verdict.line: You only lose if you get caught overextended pre-6 without Flash; from level 6 on, Realm of Death turns every stand-off into a 1v1 you should win.

brief.thesis: Malphite has almost no way to kill you in a vacuum — his damage is a slow-building poke-and-shield kit, not a burst kit, and your R (Realm of Death) deletes his entire reason for existing by removing his team from the fight. Your Q (Obliterate) also does bonus single-target damage when it only hits one champion, which is exactly the situation a lone tank in lane gives you every time. The only way Malphite generates pressure on you is through his ultimate's teamfight gravity, not through anything he can do in a 1v1.

theirWindow.when: he's missing from lane after level 6
theirWindow.what: Malphite's R (Unstoppable Force) has enormous range and he's likely walked into fog to flank a sidelane or river skirmish — ping the fight and don't let your team get caught grouped in the open.

yourWindow.when: he's alone and his Flash is down
yourWindow.what: Land E (Death's Grip) to snap him to you, then R (Realm of Death) immediately — once he's isolated in the Realm his team can't peel or follow, and your passive sustain plus single-target Q damage win the duel almost every time.

powerCurve.note: Neither side has real kill pressure without E
Q+E all-in beats his Q-poke shell
Realm of Death wins any lane duel
Granite Shield offsets poke, melee still yours
Liandry's burn plus R still ends duels

start.why: Blunts his Q (Seismic Shard) chip and minion poke while you look for E-engage windows, and the regen out-heals his early trade damage.

boots.why: Malphite's whole kit is magic damage and his R is a long-range knockup CC — tenacity and MR both matter here.

core.why: Early bruiser spike with on-hit proc and a shield that lets you win the extended trades Malphite is forced into.
Percent max-HP burn is the answer to a tank stacking armor and HP instead of MR — his resistances don't scale against this.
Omnivamp plus the true-damage execute nova turns extended duels and dives into guaranteed kills on a tank.

situational.when: their team has stacked magic damage beyond just Malphite and you need MR plus the tenacity/move speed proc
you're grouping for 5v5s and want to shred his magic resist for your whole team, not just yourself
he's stacking pure resistances and your damage is starting to feel soft through his shield and armor

runes.keystoneWhy: Morde wins by staying in extended melee trades, and Grasp's bite plus max-HP growth make every prolonged fight in lane favor you even harder.

summoners.why: Teleport lets you play the wave-priority/split-push side of this matchup where Malphite has no answer, while Flash guarantees you land the E-into-R combo he can't escape.

playing.title: Land Q point-blank
playing.detail: Walk up so Q (Obliterate) only hits Malphite — it deals bonus single-target damage when it catches just one champion, which is every trade in a 1v1 lane.

playing.title: Bait Granite Shield before committing
playing.detail: His passive absorbs a flat chunk of the first hit after a few seconds untouched — throw a minion auto or your W (Siphon of Destruction) first so the shield is already down before you commit Q and E.

playing.title: Sequence E before R, not after
playing.detail: Use E (Death's Grip) to pull him to you and guarantee the follow-up before popping R (Realm of Death) — ulting a Malphite who can just walk out of your average auto range wastes the duel window.

playing.title: Push with Demolish, don't sit in fights you don't need
playing.detail: Malphite has no all-in pre-6, so use your Q wave clear and Demolish to hit turret plates and force him to either match your push or give up CS.

playing.title: Ping his ultimate window
playing.detail: From level 6 on, a missing Malphite is going to flank a fight with a long-range knockup — call it to your team instead of assuming he's just resetting.

playing.title: Duel him with confidence at 6+
playing.detail: Once your ultimate is up, look to isolate and fight him even off-cooldown-CS situations — Realm of Death removes his team's ability to save him, and you win that 1v1 the large majority of the time.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names drift patch to patch — this is the standard Mordekaiser bruiser/AP build and Resolve-keystone setup as of my last training data, so double-check Sundered Sky, Liandry's Torment, and Riftmaker are still live items and that Grasp of the Undying and Transcendence haven't been reworked before locking in.
